method: Fill-only role reassignment within each unchanged palette. Copy, font, sizes, weights, positions, photographs/crops and print/device presentation remain fixed.

examples.name: color-roles-primary-actions
examples.description: Only the desk-price text and room-button fill change. Blue is assigned to both booking actions; the price returns to dark green. The same two ordinary ink colors remain. Copy, font, sizes, positions, photography, device and lighting stay fixed.

examples.name: color-roles-studio-report
examples.description: Only two April bar fills swap: Riverside becomes blue and Hill terracotta, matching March. All four values, direct site labels, common scale, bar geometry, type and photography remain identical. Palette unchanged. Fictional data: March42/28, April48/36.

examples.name: color-roles-order-status
examples.description: Only the payment-outstanding badge background changes from existing pale green to existing pale yellow. Ready to dispatch remains green; Address missing remains yellow. All explicit words, symbols, positions, typography and photographic artwork stay fixed. Palette unchanged.
